name: Han Liwon
source: The protagonist's childhood friend, and the very first character you meet in the story. At school, he's recognized by everyone as a model student, but beneath that polished exterior lies a playful side. That little bit of clumsiness, combined with his composed demeanor, makes the contrast all the more charming.
